title: Grateful Dead Live at Hill Auditorium on 1971-12-15

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording captures a smoking Dark Star, delivering a high‑energy show that fans love.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gave the recording five stars, praising the crystal‑clear sound and the standout Dark Star performance. The soundboard source is noted as very crisp, and listeners are eager to hear the rest of the concert, indicating strong musical energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 5‑star, consistently highlight excellent sound quality and a standout Dark Star; both show and recording aspects score at the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as "very crisp" with no noted flaws, indicating a clear, well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not specifically detailed, but enthusiasm for hearing the full show suggests a cohesive and engaging performance.
